title: Teach the proof doctrine across skill text, frame, and AGENTS.md
action: Rewrite every passage teaching the retired test cadence to the proof doctrine. BUILD YOUR OWN INVENTORY FIRST — the anchor list in 002-findings.md undercounts (~16 named vs ~52 real hits in 11 files): rg across skills/, expertise/, AGENTS.md, packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md for at least these patterns: 'commands.test', 'tests: boundary', 'tests: undeclared', 'prove at the boundary', 'proved at the boundary', 'Never build on red', 'green base'. Sweep every hit that teaches the old cadence. The doctrine, stated once and repeated consistently (D5, D2, D6, and D7/D8 as landed in commits 9731af85/892341bb/13d658e2 on this branch): the agent owns test scope — it picks the proof its change type needs (code: related tests green; docs: parity/pointer checks; behavior: judge verdict), runs it itself, and records it in the cap proof line `<command> — <result> — <scope reason>`; `bee close` and `bee worktree merge` CHECK recorded proof, they run nothing; docs-only diffs skip the suite (D2); CI runs the full declared command on every push — the one deterministic net; a scoped-green-but-CI-red miss is a fix-first cell PLUS a mandatory captured learning on why the scope missed (D6); 'never build on a red base' survives as a principle (a red proof refuses a cap), never as a pre-claim full-suite order. Specific decisions the review already made for you: (1) AGENTS.md lines 86-89 sit INSIDE the managed block — packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md is the authority; edit the block, run the regen chain, and let it rewrite AGENTS.md (never hand-edit AGENTS.md's managed block alone). (2) expertise/tests.md:407-410 ('the door runs it… bee cells finish and bee close run it as the door') is retired cadence — rewrite it; the regen chain copies expertise/ into .bee/expertise/. (3) Stale HEADINGS: gates-and-delegation.md:175 '### Test scope (one declared command, proved at the boundary)' — RENAME to a doctrine-true name and update every citer in the same commit; gates-and-delegation.md:113 '### Green base check (before the first claim)' — KEEP the heading name, rewrite the body to base-awareness under the new doctrine (know the last recorded result; scoped proof for code lanes; no mandatory full-suite), its citer routing-and-contracts.md:296 stays valid; swarming-reference.md heading 'Tests at finish and close, in full' is cited from routing-and-contracts.md:169 and gates-and-delegation.md:179-180 — if you rename it, update both citers; planning-reference.md 'Test scoping' is cited from bee-planning/SKILL.md:103 — same rule. After every heading decision run the pointer sweep: rg the exact old heading text repo-wide; pointer_integrity in the verify suite is the final guard. (4) docs/specs/test-simple.md still states the retired contract and is prohibited (read-only surface) — record this as a deviation line ('knowingly stale, compat surface'), never edit it. After the text edits run `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (render-skill-trees → onboard --repo-root . --apply → release-manifest --write); generated trees, .bee/expertise, onboarding ledger, and the manifest stay in files so reservations cover them.
